# Newline-separated regexes for paths TruffleHog should skip.
#
# Committed *.example / *.vars.example files are templates that ship
# intentionally fake credentials (postgresql://user:password@host, re_xxxx,
# your_64_char_hex_key_here). TruffleHog reports these as unverified findings,
# so every PR that adds a new template env file fails the scan.
#
# Real secrets live in Doppler and the GitHub `test` / `production`
# Environments (see .github/SECRETS.md) and are never committed, so these
# templates carry nothing worth scanning.
(^|/)\.env[^/]*\.example$
(^|/)\.dev\.vars\.example$
